Subject: Evening cohort demo: proposed staggered windows & fallbacks

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick signal that your teams are interested in a joint walkthrough. To make this usable across teams in NA and APAC, proposed approach below:

- Two staggered 60-minute windows on the same evening (UTC-friendly):
  * Window A — 20:00–21:00 UTC (evening NA / morning APAC overlap)
  * Window B — 23:00–00:00 UTC (late NA fallback + APAC earlier)
- Each window: 30m demo + 20m Q&A + 10m region-specific follow-ups (breakouts)
- Hosts: Ben will run the live demo, I’ll handle product Q&A, Soojin covers APAC breakouts
- Fallback policy: if any single company can’t make Window A, we offer Window B; if multiple companies opt out of both we’ll run a dedicated replay + 1:1 follow-ups

Can you reply with preferred window (A or B) and the attendees who need dial-in? I’ll send calendar invites + a single hub spot link for joint notes and the recording consent.

Attachments: demo-brief.pdf (agenda), regional-availability.ics (placeholder — confirm times after replies)

Thanks,
Lauren
